result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact, but one visual defect stands out: the restaurant title "Tokumaru Ramen" in the Popular right now list is cut off mid-letter, even though there is plenty of free space to its right. No other clear breakage was found.

issues.description: The restaurant title "Tokumaru Ramen" in the first Popular right now card is clipped mid-glyph: the final "n" is sliced off so it reads "Tokumaru Rameı". There is no ellipsis, and ample empty space sits between the title and the rating (4.8) on the right.
issues.suggestion: Remove the fixed or too-narrow width on the title element so it can use the available space up to the rating. If truncation is ever needed, use a proper ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) rather than a hard clip.
